shigezane.name: Neo Shigezane Zanmai
shigezane.hero_title:
The records of Date Shigezane,
made searchable.
shigezane.description: A rebuild of Shigezane Zanmai, the specialist archive on Date Shigezane (1568-1646), cousin and senior retainer of Date Masamune, using a Markdown CMS: chronology, biographies, battles, writings, letters and retainers, all in searchable form.
shigezane.subtitle: Records of a life and an age
shigezane.hero_note: Source: Shigezane Zanmai by TAKEMI Shigino
shigezane.about: This site rebuilds the Date Shigezane archive Shigezane Zanmai (by TAKEMI Shigino, http://shigezane.info/) in Markdown form under its license, Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 2.1 Japan (CC BY-SA 2.1 JP). Sources are credited in each article. Texts and photos contributed by third parties are not reproduced; they are replaced with links to the original pages. Cover images are illustrations created by AI (Muse).
